title: Daily briefing: How to rebuild science from ruin
title_zh: 每日简报：如何从废墟中重建科学
abstract: Researchers in New Orleans share lessons from the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina. Plus, budding cryptographers are using AI to crack historical codes and an enzyme that keeps cognition sharp with age.
abstract_zh: 新奥尔良的研究人员分享了飓风卡特里娜过后的经验教训。此外，初学密码学的人正在利用人工智能破解历史密码，并发现了一种能让认知随年龄保持敏锐的酶。
